module: Flowgraph node "On Testdrive Changed" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Detects the start (onTestDriveStarted hook) and the end after the fade (onTestDriveEndedAfterFade) of a vehicle test drive in career. Impulse outputs: started and ended.
notes: The node's description is "TBD" and that of the ended pin is copied from started ("when the vehicle is spawned").
work() sets back to false only started; ended stays true after an event.

work.desc: Every frame: started to false, applies then clears the flags.
